verses.ar: قَلْبُ ٱلْمَلِكِ فِي يَدِ ٱلرَّبِّ كَجَدَاوِلِ مِيَاهٍ، حَيْثُمَا شَاءَ يُمِيلُهُ.
verses.kjv: The king’s heart [is] in the hand of the LORD, [as] the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.web: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
verses.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם לֶב־מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ طُرُقِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ مُسْتَقِيمَةٌ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ، وَٱلرَّبُّ وَازِنُ ٱلْقُلُوبِ.
verses.kjv: Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
verses.he: כָּֽל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבֹּ֣ות יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: فِعْلُ ٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْحَقِّ أَفْضَلُ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلذَّبِيحَةِ.
verses.kjv: To do justice and judgment [is] more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
verses.he: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃

verses.ar: طُمُوحُ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ وَٱنْتِفَاخُ ٱلْقَلْبِ، نُورُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ خَطِيَّةٌ.
verses.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, [and] the plowing of the wicked, [is] sin.
verses.web: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.he: רוּם־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

verses.ar: أَفْكَارُ ٱلْمُجْتَهِدِ إِنَّمَا هِيَ لِلْخِصْبِ، وَكُلُّ عَجُولٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ لِلْعَوَزِ.
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenteousness; but of every one [that is] hasty only to want.
verses.web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
verses.he: מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ות חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־לְמֹותָ֑ר וְכָל־אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסֹֽור׃

verses.ar: جَمْعُ ٱلْكُنُوزِ بِلِسَانٍ كَاذِبٍ، هُوَ بُخَارٌ مَطْرُودٌ لِطَالِبِي ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue [is] a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
verses.he: פֹּ֣עַל אֹ֭וצָרֹות בִּלְשֹׁ֣ון שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

verses.ar: اِغْتِصَابُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَجْرُفُهُمْ، لِأَنَّهُمْ أَبَوْا إِجْرَاءَ ٱلْعَدْلِ.
verses.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
verses.he: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגֹורֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשֹׂ֥ות מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

verses.ar: طَرِيقُ رَجُلٍ مَوْزُورٍ هِيَ مُلْتَوِيَةٌ، أَمَّا ٱلزَّكِيُّ فَعَمَلُهُ مُسْتَقِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: The way of man [is] froward and strange: but [as for] the pure, his work [is] right.
verses.web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.he: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֹֽו׃

verses.ar: اَلسُّكْنَى فِي زَاوِيَةِ ٱلسَّطْحِ، خَيْرٌ مِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٍ مُخَاصِمَةٍ وَبَيْتٍ مُشْتَرِكٍ.
verses.kjv: [It is] better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.he: טֹ֗וב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃

verses.ar: نَفْسُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ تَشْتَهِي ٱلشَّرَّ. قَرِيبُهُ لَا يَجِدُ نِعْمَةً فِي عَيْنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָ֑ע לֹא־יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: بِمُعَاقَبَةِ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئِ يَصِيرُ ٱلْأَحْمَقُ حَكِيمًا، وَٱلْحَكِيمُ بِٱلْإِرْشَادِ يَقْبَلُ مَعْرِفَةً.
verses.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.he: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־דָּֽעַת׃

verses.ar: اَلْبَارُّ يَتَأَمَّلُ بَيْتَ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ وَيَقْلِبُ ٱلْأَشْرَارَ فِي ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: The righteous [man] wisely considereth the house of the wicked: [but God] overthroweth the wicked for [their] wickedness.
verses.web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃

verses.ar: مَنْ يَسُدُّ أُذُنَيْهِ عَنْ صُرَاخِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ، فَهُوَ أَيْضًا يَصْرُخُ وَلَا يُسْتَجَابُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
verses.he: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנֹו מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃

verses.ar: اَلْهَدِيَّةُ فِي ٱلْخَفَاءِ تَفْثَأُ ٱلْغَضَبَ، وَٱلرَّشْوَةُ فِي ٱلْحِضْنِ تَفْثَأُ ٱلسَّخَطَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ.
verses.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.web: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
verses.he: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃

verses.ar: إِجْرَاءُ ٱلْحَقِّ فَرَحٌ لِلصِّدِّيقِ، وَٱلْهَلَاكُ لِفَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: [It is] joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction [shall be] to the workers of iniquity.
verses.web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשֹׂ֣ות מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلضَّالُّ عَنْ طَرِيقِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ يَسْكُنُ بَيْنَ جَمَاعَةِ ٱلْأَخِيلَةِ.
verses.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
verses.he: אָדָ֗ם תֹּ֭ועֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃

verses.ar: مُحِبُّ ٱلْفَرَحِ إِنْسَانٌ مُعْوِزٌ. مُحِبُّ ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلدُّهْنِ لَا يَسْتَغْنِي.
verses.kjv: He that loveth pleasure [shall be] a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.web: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסֹור אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃

verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ فِدْيَةُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ، وَمَكَانَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ ٱلْغَادِرُ.
verses.kjv: The wicked [shall be] a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
verses.he: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בֹּוגֵֽד׃

verses.ar: اَلسُّكْنَى فِي أَرْضٍ بَرِّيَّةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٍ مُخَاصِمَةٍ حَرِدَةٍ.
verses.kjv: [It is] better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.he: טֹ֗וב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת *מְדֹונִים (מִדְיָנִ֣ים) וָכָֽעַס׃

verses.ar: كَنْزٌ مُشْتَهًى وَزَيْتٌ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ، أَمَّا ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْجَاهِلُ فَيُتْلِفُهُ.
verses.kjv: [There is] treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
verses.he: אֹוצָ֤ר ׀ נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: اَلتَّابِعُ ٱلْعَدْلَ وَٱلرَّحْمَةَ يَجِدُ حَيَاةً، حَظًّا وَكَرَامَةً.
verses.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.he: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: اَلْحَكِيمُ يَتَسَوَّرُ مَدِينَةَ ٱلْجَبَابِرَةِ، وَيُسْقِطُ قُوَّةَ مُعْتَمَدِهَا.
verses.kjv: A wise [man] scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.he: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃

verses.ar: مَنْ يَحْفَظُ فَمَهُ وَلِسَانَهُ، يَحْفَظُ مِنَ ٱلضِّيقَاتِ نَفْسَهُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשֹׁונֹ֑ו שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּרֹ֣ות נַפְשֹֽׁו׃

verses.ar: اَلْمُنْتَفِخُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ٱسْمُهُ «مُسْتَهْزِئٌ»، عَامِلٌ بِفَيَضَانِ ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Proud [and] haughty scorner [is] his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.web: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
verses.he: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמֹ֑ו עֹ֝ושֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֹֽון׃

verses.ar: شَهْوَةُ ٱلْكَسْلَانِ تَقْتُلُهُ، لِأَنَّ يَدَيْهِ تَأْبَيَانِ ٱلشُّغْلَ.
verses.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֹֽׂות׃

verses.ar: اَلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ يَشْتَهِي شَهْوَةً، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَيُعْطِي وَلَا يُمْسِكُ.
verses.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
verses.he: כָּל־הַ֭יֹּום הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃

verses.ar: ذَبِيحَةُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ مَكْرَهَةٌ، فَكَمْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ حِينَ يُقَدِّمُهَا بِغِشٍّ!
verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked [is] abomination: how much more, [when] he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
verses.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תֹּועֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: شَاهِدُ ٱلزُّورِ يَهْلِكُ، وَٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلسَّامِعُ لِلْحَقِّ يَتَكَلَّمُ.
verses.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.web: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
verses.he: עֵד־כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֝ומֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃

verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ يُوقِحُ وَجْهَهُ، أَمَّا ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُ فَيُثَبِّتُ طُرُقَهُ.
verses.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but [as for] the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
verses.he: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא ׀ *יָכִין (יָבִ֬ין) *דְּרָכָיו (דַּרְכֹּֽו)׃

verses.ar: لَيْسَ حِكْمَةٌ وَلَا فِطْنَةٌ وَلَا مَشُورَةٌ تُجَاهَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: [There is] no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
verses.he: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: اَلْفَرَسُ مُعَدٌّ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحَرْبِ، أَمَّا ٱلنُّصْرَةُ فَمِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: The horse [is] prepared against the day of battle: but safety [is] of the LORD.
verses.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
verses.he: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְיֹ֣ום מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
